hero_subtitle: A cooperative team game where Grover, a very good dog, teaches quantum computing. Work together to measure his hidden number before too much noise creeps in, or Grover will be one sad dog.

learning_objectives.title: Grover's Algorithm
learning_objectives.description: Experience the core intuition behind Grover's search algorithm — using interference to amplify the probability of the correct answer rising to the top.

learning_objectives.title: Constructive Interference
learning_objectives.description: When players vote YES or NO on a gate card, conflicting signals cancel out while agreeing signals amplify — mirroring how quantum interference works.

learning_objectives.title: Measurement & Collapse
learning_objectives.description: The final vote collapses all probability into a single answer — just as measuring a quantum state forces it to one outcome.
